Rajasthan government faces questions over July 31 deadline for local elections

The Rajasthan government is facing scrutiny regarding the completion of Panchayat and local body elections by July 31. State Election Commission officials have indicated that these elections may not be possible by the stated deadline. The situation has led to political questioning of the government's preparedness and timeline.
